title: Comparative analyses of anti-inflammatory effects of Resveratrol, Pterostilbene and Curcumin: in-silico and in-vitro evidences.
authors: Patil, Rashmi; Telang, Gaurang; Aswar, Urmila; Vyas, Nishant
one_liner_zh: 该文比较白藜芦醇、紫檀芪和姜黄素的抗炎作用，涉及小分子与细胞因子/SIRT1的对接及细胞实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is an adaptive response that involves activation, and recruitment of cells of innate and adaptive immune cells for restoring homeostasis. To safeguard the host from the threat of inflammatory agents, microbial invasion, or damage, the immune system activates the transcription factor NF-kappaB and produces cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL- 6, IL-1beta, and alpha. Sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) controls the increased amounts of proinflammatory cytokines, which in turn controls inflammation. Three phytoconstituents resveratrol (RES), pterostilbene (PTE), and curcumin (CUR) which are SIRT1- activators and that have marked anti-inflammatory effects (in-vivo), were chosen for the current study. These compounds were compared for their anti-inflammatory potential by in-silico docking studies for IL-6, TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, and SIRT1 and in-vitro THP-1 cell line studies for IL-6, TNF-alpha. PTE was found to be more effective than RES and CUR in lowering the concentrations of IL-6 and TNF-alpha in THP-1 cell line studies, and it also showed a favorable docking profile with cytokines and SIRT1. Thus, PTE appears to be a better choice for further research and development as a drug or functional food supplement with the ability to reduce inflammation in metabolic disorders. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT: Schematic representation of in-silico and in-vitro analysis of Resveratrol, Pterostilbene, and Curcumin.
abstract_zh: 炎症是一种适应性反应，涉及先天性和适应性免疫细胞的激活与募集，以恢复体内稳态。为保护宿主免受炎症因子、微生物入侵或损伤的威胁，免疫系统激活转录因子NF-kappaB，并产生如TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-1beta和alpha等细胞因子。Sirtuin 1（SIRT1）控制促炎细胞因子水平的升高，从而调节炎症。本研究选取了三种植物成分——白藜芦醇（RES）、紫檀芪（PTE）和姜黄素（CUR），它们均为SIRT1激活剂，并具有显著的体内抗炎作用。通过针对IL-6、TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB和SIRT1的计算机模拟对接研究，以及针对IL-6、TNF-alpha的体外THP-1细胞系研究，比较了这些化合物的抗炎潜力。结果显示，在THP-1细胞系研究中，PTE在降低IL-6和TNF-alpha浓度方面比RES和CUR更有效，并且与细胞因子和SIRT1的对接谱也表现良好。因此，PTE似乎是进一步研究和开发为药物或功能性食品补充剂的更优选择，具有减少代谢紊乱中炎症的能力。图形摘要：白藜芦醇、紫檀芪和姜黄素的计算机模拟与体外分析示意图。
